name: What is a frost-free hose bib and why do I need one in Las Vegas?

mainEntity.name: What is a frost-free hose bib and why do I need one in Las Vegas?

acceptedAnswer.text: A frost-free hose bib is an outdoor water faucet designed to prevent freezing by placing the shut-off valve inside your home's insulated wall, away from external cold. While Las Vegas doesn't experience extreme, prolonged freezes often, temperatures can drop below freezing during winter nights. Installing a frost-free hose bib prevents damage to your plumbing system, such as burst pipes, which can lead to costly repairs and water damage. It's a proactive measure to protect your home's exterior water lines from unexpected cold snaps, ensuring your outdoor water supply remains reliable.
acceptedAnswer.description: A frost-free hose bib is an outdoor faucet with an internal shut-off valve to prevent freezing. In Las Vegas, it protects your plumbing from potential damage during winter cold snaps, even if brief.
